records.literal_gloss: And Jericho [was] shutting up and shut up because of [the] sons of Israel; none going out and none coming in.

en.L: Now Jericho was shutting itself up and was shut up because of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel; no one was going out and no one was coming in.
en.B: Now Jericho was shut up tight because of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. Nobody left the city and nobody entered it.
en.R: The gates of Jericho were shut and barred because the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} were near. No one went out of the city, and no one came in.

sw.L: Basi Yeriko ulikuwa ukijifunga na ulikuwa umefungwa kwa sababu ya wana wa Israeli; hakuna aliyetoka, wala hakuna aliyeingia.
sw.B: Basi Yeriko ulikuwa umefungwa kabisa kwa sababu ya Waisraeli. Hakuna mtu aliyetoka mjini wala aliyeingia.
sw.R: Malango ya Yeriko yalikuwa yamefungwa na kuwekewa makomeo kwa sababu Waisraeli walikuwa karibu. Hakuna mtu aliyetoka mjini, wala hakuna aliyeingia.

es.L: Y Jericó se cerraba y estaba cerrada a causa de los hijos de Israel; nadie salía y nadie entraba.
es.B: Jericó estaba bien cerrada a causa de los israelitas. Nadie salía de la ciudad y nadie entraba en ella.
es.R: Las puertas de Jericó estaban cerradas y atrancadas porque los israelitas estaban cerca. Nadie salía de la ciudad y nadie entraba.

fr.L: Or Jéricho se fermait et était fermée à cause des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël ; personne ne sortait et personne n’entrait.
fr.B: Or Jéricho était solidement fermée à cause des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Personne ne sortait de la ville et personne n’y entrait.
fr.R: Les portes de Jéricho étaient fermées et barricadées, parce que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} étaient tout près. Personne ne sortait de la ville, et personne n’y entrait.

vi.L: Vả, Giê-ri-cô đang tự đóng chặt và bị đóng chặt vì con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên; không ai đi ra và không ai đi vào.
vi.B: Lúc ấy thành Giê-ri-cô đóng cửa thật chặt vì dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Không ai ra khỏi thành, cũng không ai vào thành.
vi.R: Các cổng thành Giê-ri-cô đều đóng chặt và cài then, vì dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đang ở gần. Không ai ra khỏi thành, và không ai vào thành.

ko.L: 그때 여리고는 이스라엘 자손 때문에 굳게 닫혀 있었고 닫힌 채였다. 나가는 사람도 없고 들어오는 사람도 없었다.
ko.B: 그때 여리고는 이스라엘 자손 때문에 굳게 닫혀 있었다. 아무도 성에서 나가지 못했고, 아무도 들어오지 못했다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성이 가까이 와 있었기 때문에, 여리고의 성문들은 꼭 닫히고 빗장이 질러져 있었다. 아무도 성 밖으로 나가지 않았고, 아무도 성안으로 들어오지 않았다.

decisions.choice: shutting up and shut up: closed tight
decisions.reason: The same verb comes twice, first active and then passive: the city shut itself and was kept shut. Together they say it was closed completely, with no way in or out, as the end of the verse spells out.

decisions.choice: Now Jericho ...: a pause that sets the scene
decisions.reason: The verse breaks off the story to describe the city. It stands between the meeting with the commander of the LORD's army (5:13-15) and the LORD's words to Joshua (verse 2), and shows what Israel faced: a walled city that would not come out to fight or open its gates.

decisions.choice: Jericho: a walled city in the Jordan valley
decisions.reason: Jericho stood west of the Jordan, not far from Israel's camp at Gilgal (4:19; 5:10). Its people had already heard what the LORD had done for Israel and were afraid (2:9-11; 5:1).

decisions.choice: The gates ... were shut and barred; because the Israelites were near
decisions.reason: Readable says what was shut, and gives the sense of "because of the Israelites": their nearness was the reason.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ רְאֵה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי בְיָֽדְךָ֔ אֶת־יְרִיח֖וֹ וְאֶת־מַלְכָּ֑הּ גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י הֶחָֽיִל׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Joshua, see, I have given into your hand Jericho and its king, [the] mighty men of the strength.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Joshua, "See, I have given into your hand Jericho and its king, the mighty men of valor.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Joshua, "Look, I have handed Jericho over to you, along with its king and its strong warriors.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Joshua, "Look, I have given you Jericho, with its king and its brave soldiers. It is as good as yours.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Yoshua, "Tazama, nimeutia Yeriko mkononi mwako, na mfalme wake, mashujaa wenye nguvu.
sw.B: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Yoshua, "Tazama, nimekukabidhi Yeriko, pamoja na mfalme wake na mashujaa wake hodari.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Yoshua, "Tazama, nimekupa Yeriko, pamoja na mfalme wake na askari wake shujaa. Ni kana kwamba tayari ni mali yako.

es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Josué: «Mira, te he entregado Jericó, junto con su rey y sus fuertes guerreros.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Josué: «Mira, te he dado Jericó, con su rey y sus valientes soldados. Es como si ya fuera tuya.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Josué : « Vois, j’ai livré entre tes mains Jéricho et son roi, les vaillants guerriers.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Josué : « Regarde, je t’ai livré Jéricho, avec son roi et ses valeureux guerriers.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Josué : « Regarde, je t’ai donné Jéricho, avec son roi et ses courageux soldats. C’est comme si elle était déjà à toi.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Giô-suê: "Xem, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phó vào tay ngươi Giê-ri-cô và vua nó, là những dũng sĩ mạnh mẽ.
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Giô-suê: "Hãy xem, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giao Giê-ri-cô vào tay con, cùng với vua và các chiến binh dũng mãnh của thành.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Giô-suê: "Hãy xem, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho con thành Giê-ri-cô, cùng với vua và những người lính can đảm của thành. Thành ấy coi như đã thuộc về con rồi.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여호수아에게 말씀하셨다. "보아라, 내가 여리고와 그 왕과 용사들을 네 손에 주었다.
ko.B: 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여호수아에게 말씀하셨다. "보아라, 내가 여리고와 그 왕과 그 힘센 용사들을 네 손에 넘겨주었다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여호수아에게 말씀하셨다. "보아라, 내가 여리고를 그 왕과 용감한 군인들과 함께 너에게 주었다. 그 성은 이미 네 것이나 다름없다.

decisions.choice: I have given: the victory spoken of as already done
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form for a finished action, though the city has not yet fallen. God speaks of what he has decided as already settled, as the spies did in 2:24 and the LORD does again in 8:1.

decisions.choice: given into your hand: put in your power
decisions.reason: To give someone into another's hand is to hand them over to that person's control, especially in war (2:24; Deuteronomy 7:24).

decisions.choice: its king, the mighty men of valor: the king together with his warriors
alternatives: its king, mighty men of valor (describing the king and his men together)
decisions.reason: The phrase about the warriors stands beside "its king" with no "and". It most likely adds the king's fighting men to what is handed over; it could also describe the king and his men together. The phrase means men strong and able in battle (1:14).

decisions.choice: the LORD said: the LORD speaks to Joshua, perhaps through the commander of 5:13-15
decisions.reason: Just before this, the commander of the LORD's army has met Joshua and told him to take off his sandals (5:13-15). The commander may be the one who now speaks for the LORD, or the LORD may speak to Joshua directly; the text names only the LORD.

decisions.choice: strong warriors (Balanced); brave soldiers and "It is as good as yours" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give "mighty men of valor" in current words. Readable adds a short sentence to carry the sense of the finished verb (m1): the city is certain to be Israel's.

source.text: וְסַבֹּתֶ֣ם אֶת־הָעִ֗יר כֹּ֚ל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה הַקֵּ֥יף אֶת־הָעִ֖יר פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת כֹּ֥ה תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will go around the city, all [the] men of the war, circling the city one time; thus you will do six days.

en.L: And you shall go around the city, all the men of war, circling the city one time. Thus you shall do [for] six days.
en.B: All your fighting men are to march around the city, going around it once. Do this for six days.
en.R: March around the city once with all your soldiers. Do this every day for six days.

sw.L: Nanyi mtauzunguka mji, watu wote wa vita, mkiuzunguka mji mara moja. Hivyo ndivyo mtakavyofanya siku sita.

sw.R: Pamoja na askari wako wote, uzungukeni mji mara moja. Fanyeni hivyo kila siku kwa siku sita.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:rodearán|rodearéis}} la ciudad, todos los hombres de guerra, dando una vuelta alrededor de la ciudad. Así {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} [durante] seis días.
es.B: Todos tus hombres de guerra marcharán alrededor de la ciudad, dándole una vuelta. {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} esto durante seis días.
es.R: Marcha alrededor de la ciudad una vez con todos tus soldados. {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} esto todos los días durante seis días.

fr.B: Tous vos hommes de guerre feront le tour de la ville, une fois. Fais ainsi pendant six jours.
fr.R: Avec tous tes soldats, faites une fois le tour de la ville. Faites cela chaque jour pendant six jours.

vi.R: Hãy cùng tất cả binh lính của con đi vòng quanh thành một lần. Hãy làm như vậy mỗi ngày trong sáu ngày.

ko.L: 너희, 곧 모든 군사는 성을 돌되, 성 둘레를 한 번 돌아라. 엿새 동안 그렇게 하여라.

decisions.choice: you shall go around, all the men of war: the whole army marches
decisions.reason: The verb "you shall go around" is plural, and "all the men of war" names who "you" are: the whole fighting force, not Joshua alone. The next command, "thus you shall do", is singular, spoken to Joshua as the leader of them all.

decisions.choice: go around ... circling: a procession around the walls
decisions.reason: Two verbs of going around describe the march that fills the chapter. It is a procession around the city, not an attack on its walls.

decisions.choice: march around
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "march", the plain sense of an army going around a city in order; Literal keeps "go around".

decisions.choice: plural "you" at Literal for the marching army; "tú" with "hagan" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verbs are plural: the whole army is addressed through Joshua. Literal keeps the plural forms; Balanced and Readable speak to Joshua about "tus hombres de guerra" and then give the command to all of them with "hagan" ("haced"), as the English moves from "your" to "Do this".

decisions.choice: God's orders here: "các ngươi" (L), "con" with "chiến sĩ của con" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns to a plural "you", the whole army. Literal shows the plural; Balanced and Readable keep God speaking to Joshua as "con" and name the soldiers, which says the same thing in natural Vietnamese.

records.literal_gloss: And seven priests will carry seven trumpets of the rams' horns before the ark; and on the day the seventh you will go around the city seven times, and the priests will blow on the trumpets.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장 일곱 명은 숫양 뿔나팔 일곱 개를 들고 궤 앞에서 가거라. 그리고 일곱째 날에는 너희가 성을 일곱 번 돌고, 제사장들은 나팔을 불어라.
ko.B: 제사장 일곱 명은 숫양 뿔나팔 일곱 개를 들고 궤 앞에서 가야 한다. 일곱째 날에는 너희가 성 둘레를 일곱 번 돌고, 제사장들은 그 뿔나팔을 불어야 한다.
ko.R: 제사장 일곱 명에게 숫양의 뿔로 만든 나팔 일곱 개를 들게 하여라. 그들은 궤 앞에서 걸어갈 것이다. 일곱째 날에는 너희가 모두 성 둘레를 일곱 번 돌고, 제사장들은 나팔을 불 것이다.

decisions.choice: trumpets of the rams' horns: horns of rams, blown as signals
decisions.reason: The instrument is the ram's horn blown to give a signal, not the metal trumpets of Numbers 10:2. The second word also gives its name to the year of jubilee, which such a horn announced (Leviticus 25:9-10); here it names the ram whose horn it is (Exodus 19:13).

decisions.choice: seven: a pattern of completeness
decisions.reason: Seven runs through the account: seven priests, seven horns, seven days, and seven circuits on the seventh day. In Scripture seven often marks a whole that God has set apart (Genesis 2:2-3; Leviticus 25:8). The pattern shows the taking of Jericho as a holy act done in God's way, not an ordinary siege.

decisions.choice: the ark: the chest that held the covenant and stood for the LORD's presence
decisions.reason: The ark held the tablets of the covenant and was the sign of the LORD's presence among his people (3:3, 11; Exodus 25:16, 22). With the horns going before it, the procession shows the LORD himself going around the city.

decisions.choice: trumpets of the rams' horns (Literal); rams' horns, then horns (Balanced); trumpets made from rams' horns, then trumpets (Readable)
alternatives: ram's horn at every level, as in Exodus 19
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah 27:13, Literal and Readable use the familiar word "trumpet" and Balanced names the instrument, "ram's horn". Where the Hebrew adds "of the rams' horns", every level says what the horns were made of; where it has the first word alone, Literal and Readable say "trumpets" and Balanced "horns". The same choice holds through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "baragumu za pembe za kondoo dume"; then "baragumu"
decisions.reason: For the whole of Joshua, following the terms note for these books: the shofar is "baragumu", the Swahili word for a horn blown as a signal; the first mention says what it was made of. "Tarumbeta" suggests a metal trumpet.

decisions.choice: "cuernos de los carneros" (Literal); "cuernos de carnero", then "cuernos" (Balanced); "trompetas hechas de cuerno de carnero", then "trompetas" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "cuerno de carnero" for the shofar. Literal keeps the Hebrew "horns of the rams"; Balanced names the instrument; Readable uses the familiar word "trompeta" and says once what the trumpets were made of, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "trompes, des cors de bélier" (Literal); "cors de bélier", then "cor" (Balanced); "trompettes faites de cornes de bélier", then "trompettes" (Readable)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Joshua 1-12: the instrument is a ram's horn, not a metal trumpet. The terms note sets "cor de bélier"; Readable says what it was made of and then calls it a "trompette", the plain word for an instrument one blows, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "kèn bằng sừng cừu đực" (L), "kèn sừng cừu đực" (B), "kèn làm bằng sừng cừu đực" (R); then "kèn"
decisions.reason: The key term the terms note sets for the ram's horn (shofar) in these books, its first use in this block. After it is named, every level says simply "kèn". "tù và" is a horn blown in Vietnamese villages, but it would hide that this one is a ram's horn used in worship.

decisions.choice: "숫양 뿔나팔" (L, B); "숫양의 뿔로 만든 나팔", then "나팔" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms of this translation give "숫양 뿔나팔" for the ram's horn (*shofar*); Readable says plainly what it was made of and then calls it a trumpet, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וְהָיָ֞ה בִּמְשֹׁ֣ךְ׀בְּקֶ֣רֶן הַיּוֹבֵ֗ל כְּשָׁמְעֲכֶם֙ אֶת־ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֔ר יָרִ֥יעוּ כָל־הָעָ֖ם תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וְנָ֨פְלָ֜ה חוֹמַ֤ת הָעִיר֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יהָ וְעָל֥וּ הָעָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ נֶגְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, at blowing long on [the] horn of the ram, at your hearing the sound of the trumpet, will shout all the people a shout great, and will fall the wall of the city under it, and will go up the people, each before him.

en.L: And it shall be, when [they] blow long on the horn of the ram, when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout a great shout, and the wall of the city shall fall down in its place, and the people shall go up, each one straight before him."
en.B: When they sound a long blast on the ram's horn and you hear the sound of the horn, all the people are to give a great shout. Then the city wall will collapse where it stands, and the people will go up into the city, each of them straight ahead."
en.R: When you hear the priests blow one long blast on the trumpet, all the people must shout as loud as they can. Then the city wall will fall down flat, and everyone can go straight into the city from where they stand."

sw.L: Na itakuwa, [watakapo]piga kwa muda mrefu pembe ya kondoo dume, mtakaposikia sauti ya baragumu, watu wote watapiga kelele kuu, na ukuta wa mji utaanguka mahali pake, na watu watapanda, kila mmoja moja kwa moja mbele yake."
sw.B: Watakapopiga baragumu ya pembe ya kondoo dume kwa sauti ndefu, nanyi mkaisikia sauti ya baragumu, watu wote wapige kelele kuu. Ndipo ukuta wa mji utakapoanguka pale ulipo, na watu wataingia mjini, kila mmoja moja kwa moja mbele yake."
sw.R: Mtakaposikia makuhani wakipiga baragumu kwa sauti moja ndefu, watu wote lazima wapige kelele kwa nguvu zao zote. Ndipo ukuta wa mji utakapoanguka chini kabisa, na kila mtu ataweza kuingia mjini moja kwa moja kutoka mahali aliposimama."

es.L: Y sucederá que, cuando toquen largamente el cuerno del carnero, cuando {{plural_you:oigan|oigáis}} el sonido del cuerno, todo el pueblo gritará con gran grito, y la muralla de la ciudad caerá en su lugar, y el pueblo subirá, cada uno derecho delante de sí».
es.B: Cuando toquen un toque largo con el cuerno de carnero y {{plural_you:oigan|oigáis}} el sonido del cuerno, todo el pueblo lanzará un gran grito. Entonces la muralla de la ciudad se derrumbará donde está, y el pueblo subirá a la ciudad, cada uno derecho hacia adelante».
es.R: Cuando {{plural_you:oigan|oigáis}} que los sacerdotes tocan un toque largo con la trompeta, todo el pueblo tiene que gritar lo más fuerte que pueda. Entonces la muralla de la ciudad se vendrá abajo, y todos {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} entrar directamente en la ciudad desde donde estén».

fr.L: Et il arrivera, quand on sonnera longuement de la corne du bélier, quand vous entendrez le son de la trompe, que tout le peuple poussera une grande clameur, et la muraille de la ville tombera sur place, et le peuple montera, chacun droit devant lui. »
fr.B: Quand on sonnera un long coup de cor de bélier et que vous entendrez le son du cor, tout le peuple poussera une grande clameur. Alors la muraille de la ville s’écroulera sur place, et le peuple montera dans la ville, chacun droit devant lui. »
fr.R: Quand vous entendrez les prêtres sonner un long coup de trompette, tout le peuple devra crier aussi fort que possible. Alors la muraille de la ville s’écroulera complètement, et chacun pourra entrer tout droit dans la ville, de l’endroit où il se trouve. »

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra, khi [người ta] thổi một hồi dài bằng sừng cừu đực, khi các ngươi nghe tiếng kèn, thì cả dân hãy reo hò một tiếng lớn, và tường thành sẽ đổ sập tại chỗ, và dân sẽ đi lên, mỗi người thẳng phía trước mình."
vi.B: Khi họ thổi một hồi dài bằng kèn sừng cừu đực và các con nghe tiếng kèn, thì cả dân phải reo hò một tiếng thật lớn. Khi ấy tường thành sẽ đổ sập tại chỗ, và dân sẽ tiến lên vào thành, mỗi người đi thẳng phía trước mình."
vi.R: Khi các con nghe các thầy tế lễ thổi một hồi kèn dài, thì cả dân phải reo hò thật lớn. Khi ấy tường thành sẽ đổ sập xuống, và mọi người có thể từ chỗ mình đứng đi thẳng vào thành."

ko.L: 그리고 숫양 뿔을 길게 불어, 너희가 그 나팔 소리를 들으면, 온 백성은 큰 소리로 외쳐라. 그러면 성벽이 그 자리에서 무너져 내릴 것이니, 백성은 저마다 자기 앞으로 곧장 올라가거라."
ko.B: 숫양 뿔나팔을 길게 불어 너희가 그 소리를 들으면, 온 백성은 크게 함성을 질러라. 그러면 성벽이 그 자리에서 무너져 내릴 것이고, 백성은 저마다 앞으로 곧장 성안으로 올라갈 것이다."
ko.R: 제사장들이 나팔을 길게 한 번 부는 소리가 들리면, 온 백성은 있는 힘을 다해 소리를 질러라. 그러면 성벽이 무너져 내릴 것이다. 그러면 모두가 저마다 서 있던 곳에서 곧장 성안으로 들어갈 수 있을 것이다."

decisions.choice: when you hear: the read form
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the Hebrew text begin this word with a letter meaning "in", while the vowels and the reading tradition give a letter meaning "as". Both mean "when you hear". The pinned data follows the read form. Reviewers should check this against the manuscript notes.

decisions.choice: fall under itself: collapse where it stands
decisions.reason: The wall is said to fall "under it", in its own place: it falls flat and leaves the way open, rather than being broken through at one point. The same words come in verse 20.

decisions.choice: each straight before him: every one straight ahead
decisions.reason: With the wall down there is no gate or breach to look for. Each goes up from where he stands straight into the city (verse 20).

decisions.choice: a great shout: a loud battle cry
decisions.reason: The shout is the loud cry raised by an army as it goes into battle (1 Samuel 17:20, 52). Here the people raise it at God's command, and the victory follows.

decisions.choice: the priests blow (Readable); go up into the city (Balanced and Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names no one who blows the horn; Readable names the priests, from verse 4. Balanced and Readable say where the people go up, from verse 20.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֞א יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן־נוּן֙ אֶל־הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם שְׂא֖וּ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֑ית וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה כֹֽהֲנִ֗ים יִשְׂאוּ֙ שִׁבְעָ֤ה שֽׁוֹפְרוֹת֙ יוֹבְלִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And called Joshua son of Nun to the priests and said to them, lift up [the] ark of the covenant, and seven priests will carry seven trumpets of rams' horns before [the] ark of Yahweh.

en.L: And Joshua son of Nun called the priests and said to them, "Lift up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests carry seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: So Joshua son of Nun summoned the priests and said to them, "Lift up the ark of the covenant. Seven priests are to go ahead of the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, carrying seven rams' horns."
en.R: So Joshua son of Nun called the priests together. He said, "Pick up the ark of the covenant, the sacred chest. Seven of you must carry seven trumpets made from rams' horns and walk in front of the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

sw.L: Yoshua mwana wa Nuni akawaita makuhani, akawaambia, "Liinueni sanduku la agano, na makuhani saba wabebe baragumu saba za pembe za kondoo dume mbele ya sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Basi Yoshua mwana wa Nuni aliwaita makuhani, akawaambia, "Liinueni sanduku la agano. Makuhani saba walitangulie sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakibeba baragumu saba za pembe za kondoo dume."
sw.R: Basi Yoshua mwana wa Nuni aliwaita makuhani pamoja. Akasema, "Libebeni sanduku la agano, lile sanduku takatifu. Saba kati yenu wabebe baragumu saba za pembe za kondoo dume, watembee mbele ya sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

es.L: Y Josué hijo de Nun llamó a los sacerdotes y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} el arca del pacto, y que siete sacerdotes lleven siete cuernos de carnero delante del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».
es.B: Así que Josué hijo de Nun convocó a los sacerdotes y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} el arca del pacto. Siete sacerdotes irán delante del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llevando siete cuernos de carnero».
es.R: Entonces Josué hijo de Nun reunió a los sacerdotes. Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Levanten|Levantad}} el arca del pacto, el cofre sagrado. Siete de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} llevarán siete trompetas hechas de cuerno de carnero e irán delante del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et Josué fils de Noun appela les prêtres et leur dit : « Soulevez l’arche de l’alliance, et que sept prêtres portent sept trompes de cors de bélier devant l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Josué fils de Noun convoqua donc les prêtres et leur dit : « Prenez l’arche de l’alliance. Que sept prêtres marchent devant l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} en portant sept cors de bélier. »
fr.R: Josué fils de Noun a donc réuni les prêtres. Il leur a dit : « Prenez l’arche de l’alliance, le coffre sacré. Sept d’entre vous doivent porter sept trompettes faites de cornes de bélier et marcher devant l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »

vi.L: Và Giô-suê con trai Nun gọi các thầy tế lễ và nói với họ: "Hãy khiêng hòm giao ước, và bảy thầy tế lễ hãy cầm bảy cây kèn bằng sừng cừu đực đi trước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.B: Vậy Giô-suê con trai Nun triệu tập các thầy tế lễ và bảo họ: "Hãy khiêng hòm giao ước lên. Bảy thầy tế lễ phải cầm bảy cây kèn sừng cừu đực đi trước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.R: Vậy Giô-suê con trai Nun gọi các thầy tế lễ lại. Ông nói: "Hãy khiêng hòm giao ước, tức là chiếc hòm thánh, lên. Bảy người trong các ông phải cầm bảy cây kèn làm bằng sừng cừu đực và đi trước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."

ko.L: 그러자 눈의 아들 여호수아가 제사장들을 불러 그들에게 말했다. "언약궤를 메어라. 그리고 제사장 일곱 명은 숫양 뿔나팔 일곱 개를 들고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 앞에서 가거라."
ko.B: 그래서 눈의 아들 여호수아가 제사장들을 불러 그들에게 말했다. "언약궤를 메어라. 제사장 일곱 명은 숫양 뿔나팔 일곱 개를 들고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 앞에서 가거라."
ko.R: 그래서 눈의 아들 여호수아가 제사장들을 불러 모았다. 여호수아가 말했다. "언약궤, 곧 그 거룩한 궤를 메어라. 너희 가운데 일곱 명은 숫양의 뿔로 만든 나팔 일곱 개를 들고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 앞에서 걸어가거라."

decisions.choice: seven priests shall carry: an instruction
decisions.reason: The verb is a future form used as a command, as in verse 4. Joshua passes on the LORD's words to the priests nearly as he received them.

decisions.choice: the ark of the covenant, the ark of the LORD: two names for one ark
decisions.reason: The ark is named by what it holds, the covenant (Deuteronomy 10:1-5), and in the same sentence by whom it belongs to, the LORD. The two names alternate through the chapter.

decisions.choice: the sacred chest
decisions.reason: Readable explains "ark" once in the chapter, as in Numbers 10:33, and keeps the word "ark".

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־הָעָ֔ם עִבְר֖וּ וְסֹ֣בּוּ אֶת־הָעִ֑יר וְהֶ֣חָל֔וּץ יַעֲבֹ֕ר לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to the people, pass on and go around the city, and the armed [one] will pass on before [the] ark of Yahweh.

en.L: And he said to the people, "Pass on, and go around the city, and let the armed [men] pass on before the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: And he told the people, "Go forward and march around the city, with the armed men going on ahead of the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: Then he told the people, "Move out and march around the city. The soldiers with weapons must go in front of the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

sw.L: Akawaambia watu, "Piteni, mkauzunguke mji, na wenye silaha wapite mbele ya sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Akawaambia watu, "Songeni mbele, mkauzunguke mji, na wenye silaha walitangulie sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Kisha akawaambia watu, "Ondokeni, mkauzunguke mji. Askari wenye silaha lazima watangulie mbele ya sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

es.L: Y dijo al pueblo: «{{plural_you:Pasen|Pasad}} y {{plural_you:rodeen|rodead}} la ciudad, y que los armados pasen delante del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».
es.B: Y dijo al pueblo: «{{plural_you:Avancen|Avanzad}} y {{plural_you:marchen|marchad}} alrededor de la ciudad, y que los hombres armados vayan delante del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».
es.R: Luego le dijo al pueblo: «{{plural_you:Pónganse|Poneos}} en marcha y {{plural_you:marchen|marchad}} alrededor de la ciudad. Los soldados con armas irán delante del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et il dit au peuple : « Avancez, et faites le tour de la ville, et que [les hommes] armés passent devant l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Puis il dit au peuple : « Avancez et faites le tour de la ville, les hommes armés marchant devant l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Ensuite, il a dit au peuple : « En avant ! Faites le tour de la ville. Les soldats armés doivent marcher devant l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »

vi.L: Và ông nói với dân: "Hãy đi tới, và đi vòng quanh thành, và những [người] vũ trang hãy đi trước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.B: Ông cũng bảo dân: "Hãy tiến lên và đi vòng quanh thành, những người vũ trang đi trước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.R: Rồi ông bảo dân: "Hãy lên đường và đi vòng quanh thành. Những người lính cầm vũ khí phải đi trước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 백성에게 말했다. "나아가서 성을 돌아라. 그리고 무장한 사람들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 앞에서 나아가거라."
ko.B: 그리고 그가 백성에게 말했다. "앞으로 나아가 성 둘레를 행진하여라. 무장한 사람들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤보다 앞서 나아가거라."
ko.R: 그리고 여호수아는 백성에게 말했다. "출발하여 성 둘레를 행진하여라. 무기를 든 군인들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 앞에서 가거라."

decisions.choice: and he said: the read form
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the Hebrew text read "and they said", as if the leaders passed the order on; the vowels and the reading tradition give "and he said", with Joshua as the speaker, as in verse 6. The pinned data follows the read form. Either way the command is Joshua's. Reviewers should check this against the manuscript notes.

decisions.choice: the armed men: soldiers equipped for battle
decisions.reason: The word means men stripped for action, armed and ready to fight. It is used of the armed men of the eastern tribes who crossed ahead of Israel (4:12-13; Numbers 32:21). Here the singular stands for the whole armed company.

decisions.choice: the armed [men] (Literal); armed men (Balanced); soldiers with weapons (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is one word used for a group. Literal supplies "men" in brackets; Readable says it in plain words.

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י כֶּאֱמֹ֣ר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ אֶל־הָעָם֒ וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאִים֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֤וֹת הַיּֽוֹבְלִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עָבְר֕וּ וְתָקְע֖וּ בַּשּֽׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וַֽאֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה הֹלֵ֖ךְ אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, as had spoken Joshua to the people, and seven the priests carrying seven trumpets of the rams' horns before Yahweh passed on and blew on the trumpets, and [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh going after them.

en.L: And it was, when Joshua had spoken to the people, that the seven priests carrying seven trumpets of the rams' horns before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} passed on and blew on the trumpets, and the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was going after them.
en.B: As soon as Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven rams' horns before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} went forward blowing the horns, with the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} coming after them.
en.R: As soon as Joshua had given the order, the seven priests started out. They blew their trumpets as they walked ahead of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came along behind them.

sw.L: Ikawa Yoshua alipokwisha kuwaambia watu, wale makuhani saba waliobeba baragumu saba za pembe za kondoo dume mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wakapita, wakapiga baragumu, na sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likawafuata nyuma yao.
sw.B: Mara Yoshua alipomaliza kusema na watu, wale makuhani saba waliobeba baragumu saba mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} walisonga mbele wakipiga baragumu, na sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likawafuata.
sw.R: Mara Yoshua alipotoa agizo, wale makuhani saba walianza kwenda. Walipiga baragumu zao huku wakitembea mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likaja nyuma yao.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando Josué habló al pueblo, los siete sacerdotes que llevaban los siete cuernos de los carneros delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} pasaron y tocaron los cuernos, y el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} iba tras ellos.
es.B: En cuanto Josué habló al pueblo, los siete sacerdotes que llevaban los siete cuernos de carnero delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} avanzaron tocando los cuernos, y el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} iba tras ellos.
es.R: En cuanto Josué dio la orden, los siete sacerdotes se pusieron en marcha. Tocaban las trompetas mientras caminaban delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} venía detrás de ellos.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Josué eut parlé au peuple, que les sept prêtres qui portaient sept trompes de cors de bélier devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avancèrent et sonnèrent des trompes, et l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} les suivait.
fr.B: Dès que Josué eut parlé au peuple, les sept prêtres qui portaient les sept cors de bélier devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’avancèrent en sonnant du cor, et l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} venait derrière eux.
fr.R: Dès que Josué a donné l’ordre, les sept prêtres se sont mis en route. Ils soufflaient dans leurs trompettes en marchant devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} venait derrière eux.

vi.L: Và xảy ra, khi Giô-suê đã nói với dân, thì bảy thầy tế lễ cầm bảy cây kèn bằng sừng cừu đực đi trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đi tới và thổi kèn, và hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đi theo sau họ.
vi.B: Ngay khi Giô-suê nói với dân xong, bảy thầy tế lễ cầm bảy cây kèn sừng cừu đực đi trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tiến lên và thổi kèn, còn hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đi theo sau họ.
vi.R: Ngay khi Giô-suê ra lệnh xong, bảy thầy tế lễ bắt đầu đi. Họ vừa đi trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vừa thổi kèn, và hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đi theo sau họ.

ko.L: 그리고 여호수아가 백성에게 말하자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 숫양 뿔나팔 일곱 개를 든 일곱 제사장이 나아가며 나팔을 불었고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤는 그들 뒤를 따라갔다.
ko.B: 여호수아가 백성에게 말을 마치자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 숫양 뿔나팔 일곱 개를 든 일곱 제사장이 나팔을 불며 나아갔고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤가 그들 뒤를 따라갔다.
ko.R: 여호수아가 명령을 내리자, 일곱 제사장이 출발했다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 걸어가며 나팔을 불었고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤가 그들 뒤를 따라갔다.

decisions.choice: before the LORD: in front of the ark, where the LORD is present
decisions.reason: Where verse 6 says "before the ark of the LORD", this verse says "before the LORD". The ark is so closely bound to the LORD's presence that to go ahead of it is to go ahead of him (Numbers 10:35-36).

decisions.choice: passed on and blew: they set out sounding the horns
decisions.reason: The two verbs describe one movement: the priests went forward and sounded the horns as they went.

decisions.choice: had given the order
decisions.reason: Readable says what Joshua's speaking was: the order of verses 6-7.

source.text: וְהֶחָל֣וּץ הֹלֵ֔ךְ לִפְנֵי֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים תֹּקְעֵ֖י הַשּֽׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וְהַֽמְאַסֵּ֗ף הֹלֵךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י הָאָר֔וֹן הָל֖וֹךְ וְתָק֥וֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And the armed [one] going before the priests blowing the trumpets, and the rear guard going after the ark, going and blowing on the trumpets.

en.L: And the armed [men] were going before the priests who were blowing the trumpets, and the rear guard was going after the ark, going on and blowing on the trumpets.
en.B: The armed men went on ahead of the priests who were sounding the horns, and the rear guard came behind the ark, with the horns sounding without a break.
en.R: The soldiers with weapons went in front of the priests who were blowing the trumpets. Another group of soldiers followed behind the ark. All the time they marched, the trumpets kept on sounding.

sw.L: Na wenye silaha walikwenda mbele ya makuhani waliopiga baragumu, na walinzi wa nyuma walikwenda nyuma ya sanduku, wakienda na kupiga baragumu.
sw.B: Wenye silaha walitangulia mbele ya makuhani waliokuwa wakipiga baragumu, na walinzi wa nyuma walifuata nyuma ya sanduku, baragumu zikilia bila kukoma.
sw.R: Askari wenye silaha walitembea mbele ya makuhani waliokuwa wakipiga baragumu. Kikundi kingine cha askari kilifuata nyuma ya sanduku. Muda wote walipokuwa wakitembea, baragumu ziliendelea kulia.

es.L: Y los armados iban delante de los sacerdotes que tocaban los cuernos, y la retaguardia iba tras el arca, andando y tocando los cuernos.
es.B: Los hombres armados iban delante de los sacerdotes que tocaban los cuernos, y la retaguardia venía detrás del arca, mientras los cuernos sonaban sin parar.
es.R: Los soldados con armas iban delante de los sacerdotes que tocaban las trompetas. Otro grupo de soldados iba detrás del arca. Todo el tiempo que marchaban, las trompetas seguían sonando.

fr.L: Et [les hommes] armés marchaient devant les prêtres qui sonnaient des trompes, et l’arrière-garde marchait derrière l’arche ; on marchait et on sonnait des trompes.
fr.B: Les hommes armés marchaient devant les prêtres qui sonnaient du cor, et l’arrière-garde suivait l’arche, au son continu des cors.
fr.R: Les soldats armés marchaient devant les prêtres qui soufflaient dans les trompettes. Un autre groupe de soldats suivait derrière l’arche. Pendant toute la marche, les trompettes n’arrêtaient pas de sonner.

vi.L: Và những [người] vũ trang đi trước các thầy tế lễ đang thổi kèn, và đội hậu quân đi sau hòm, vừa đi vừa thổi kèn.
vi.B: Những người vũ trang đi trước các thầy tế lễ đang thổi kèn, còn đội hậu quân đi sau hòm, trong khi tiếng kèn vang lên không ngớt.
vi.R: Những người lính cầm vũ khí đi trước các thầy tế lễ đang thổi kèn. Một toán lính khác đi theo sau hòm giao ước. Suốt thời gian họ đi, tiếng kèn vẫn vang lên không ngớt.

ko.L: 그리고 무장한 사람들은 나팔을 부는 제사장들 앞에서 갔고, 후위대는 궤 뒤를 따라갔으며, 나팔은 계속 울렸다.
ko.B: 무장한 사람들은 나팔을 부는 제사장들보다 앞서 갔고, 후위대는 궤 뒤를 따라왔다. 나팔 소리는 쉬지 않고 울렸다.
ko.R: 무기를 든 군인들은 나팔을 부는 제사장들 앞에서 걸어갔다. 또 다른 군인들은 궤 뒤를 따라왔다. 그들이 행진하는 동안 나팔 소리가 계속 울렸다.

decisions.choice: who were blowing: the read form
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the Hebrew text can be read "they blew", while the vowels and the reading tradition give "blowing". The sense is the same. The pinned data follows the read form. Reviewers should check this against the manuscript notes.

decisions.choice: the rear guard: the troops who close the column
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "gather": the company at the back that keeps the column together and guards it from behind. Numbers 10:25 uses it of the tribe of Dan, the rear guard of all the camps.

decisions.choice: going and blowing: the horns sounded all the way around
decisions.reason: Two verb forms with no stated subject describe action that went on without a break. The ones blowing are the priests (verses 4, 8). The point is that the horns sounded the whole time, while the people kept silent (verse 10).

decisions.choice: Another group of soldiers
decisions.reason: Readable says who the rear guard were in plain words.

source.text: וְאֶת־הָעָם֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹ֤א תָרִ֨יעוּ֙ וְלֹֽא־תַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ אֶת־קוֹלְכֶ֔ם וְלֹא־יֵצֵ֥א מִפִּיכֶ֖ם דָּבָ֑ר עַ֠ד י֣וֹם אָמְרִ֧י אֲלֵיכֶ֛ם הָרִ֖יעוּ וַהֲרִיעֹתֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [as for] the people, commanded Joshua saying, not you will shout and not you will make heard your voice, and not will go out from your mouth a word, until [the] day I say to you, shout; and you will shout.

en.L: And Joshua commanded the people, saying, "You shall not shout, and you shall not let your voice be heard, and a word shall not go out of your mouth, until the day I say to you, 'Shout!' Then you shall shout."
en.B: Joshua had given the people this order: "Do not shout. Do not let your voices be heard. Not a word is to leave your mouths until the day I tell you, 'Shout!' Then you will shout."
en.R: Joshua had told the people, "Do not shout. Do not make any noise. Do not say a single word until the day I tell you to shout. Then you must shout!"

sw.L: Na Yoshua akawaamuru watu, akisema, "Msipige kelele, wala msiifanye sauti yenu isikike, wala neno lisitoke vinywani mwenu, mpaka siku nitakapowaambia, 'Pigeni kelele!' Ndipo mtapiga kelele."
sw.B: Yoshua alikuwa amewapa watu agizo hili: "Msipige kelele. Msiziache sauti zenu zisikike. Neno lolote lisitoke vinywani mwenu mpaka siku nitakapowaambia, 'Pigeni kelele!' Ndipo mtakapopiga kelele."
sw.R: Yoshua alikuwa amewaambia watu, "Msipige kelele. Msitoe sauti yoyote. Msiseme neno hata moja mpaka siku nitakapowaambia mpige kelele. Ndipo mpige kelele!"

es.L: Y Josué mandó al pueblo, diciendo: «No {{plural_you:gritarán|gritaréis}}, ni {{plural_you:dejarán|dejaréis}} oír {{plural_you:su voz|vuestra voz}}, ni saldrá palabra de {{plural_you:su boca|vuestra boca}}, hasta el día en que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} diga: “¡Griten!”. Entonces {{plural_you:gritarán|gritaréis}}».
es.B: Josué le había dado al pueblo esta orden: «No {{plural_you:griten|gritéis}}. No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} oír {{plural_you:sus voces|vuestras voces}}. Que no salga ni una palabra de {{plural_you:su boca|vuestra boca}} hasta el día en que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} diga: “¡Griten!”. Entonces {{plural_you:gritarán|gritaréis}}».
es.R: Josué le había dicho al pueblo: «No {{plural_you:griten|gritéis}}. No {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} ningún ruido. No {{plural_you:digan|digáis}} ni una sola palabra hasta el día en que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} diga que {{plural_you:griten|gritéis}}. ¡Entonces {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} que gritar!».

fr.L: Et au peuple, Josué avait commandé, en disant : « Vous ne pousserez pas de clameur, et vous ne ferez pas entendre votre voix, et il ne sortira pas une parole de votre bouche, jusqu’au jour où je vous dirai : “Poussez une clameur !” Alors vous pousserez une clameur. »
fr.B: Josué avait donné cet ordre au peuple : « Ne poussez pas de cri. Ne faites pas entendre votre voix. Qu’aucune parole ne sorte de votre bouche jusqu’au jour où je vous dirai : “Criez !” Alors vous crierez. »
fr.R: Josué avait dit au peuple : « Ne criez pas. Ne faites pas de bruit. Ne dites pas un seul mot jusqu’au jour où je vous dirai de crier. Alors, il faudra crier ! »

vi.L: Và Giô-suê truyền lệnh cho dân rằng: "Các ngươi chớ reo hò, chớ để người ta nghe tiếng các ngươi, và chớ để một lời nào ra khỏi miệng các ngươi, cho đến ngày ta bảo các ngươi: 'Hãy reo hò!' Bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ reo hò."
vi.B: Giô-suê đã truyền cho dân lệnh này: "Đừng reo hò. Đừng để ai nghe tiếng anh em. Không một lời nào được ra khỏi miệng anh em, cho đến ngày tôi bảo anh em: 'Hãy reo hò!' Bấy giờ anh em sẽ reo hò."
vi.R: Giô-suê đã dặn dân: "Đừng reo hò. Đừng gây một tiếng động nào. Đừng nói một lời nào cho đến ngày tôi bảo anh em reo hò. Khi ấy anh em phải reo hò!"

ko.L: 그리고 여호수아가 백성에게 명령하여 말했다. "너희는 외치지 말고, 너희 목소리를 들리게 하지 말며, 너희 입에서 한마디 말도 나오지 않게 하여라. 내가 너희에게 '외쳐라!' 하고 말하는 날까지 그렇게 하다가, 그때에 외쳐라."
ko.B: 여호수아는 백성에게 이렇게 명령해 두었다. "외치지 마라. 너희 목소리가 들리지 않게 하여라. 내가 너희에게 '외쳐라!' 하고 말하는 날까지 너희 입에서 한마디도 나오지 않게 하여라. 그때에 외쳐라."
ko.R: 여호수아는 백성에게 이렇게 말해 두었다. "소리 지르지 마라. 아무 소리도 내지 마라. 내가 소리 지르라고 말하는 날까지 한마디도 하지 마라. 그때에 크게 소리 질러라!"

decisions.choice: the people Joshua commanded: an order already given
decisions.reason: The sentence puts "the people" first, which marks a step aside from the march. It tells what Joshua had ordered the people to do as they went.

decisions.choice: silence until the shout: the people wait for God's signal
decisions.reason: Three commands in a row forbid any noise: no shout, no voice, not a word. For six days the only sound is the horns before the ark. The people's part is to obey and wait for the moment God has set (verse 16).

decisions.choice: had given ... this order (Balanced); had told (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable show that the order stands behind the march already under way (m1). Readable gives Joshua's "Shout!" as reported speech.

decisions.choice: Joshua says "ta" to the people at Literal, "tôi" with "anh em" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the plain distance of a commander's order ("ta" ... "các ngươi"); Balanced and Readable use "tôi" and "anh em", the way a leader speaks to his own people, as in 1:11.

source.text: וַיַּסֵּ֤ב אֲרוֹן־יְהוָה֙ אֶת־הָעִ֔יר הַקֵּ֖ף פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיָּלִ֖ינוּ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And he caused to go around [the] ark of Yahweh the city, circling one time; and they came [to] the camp and they spent the night in the camp.

en.L: And he made the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} go around the city, circling [it] one time. And they came [into] the camp and spent the night in the camp.
en.B: So he had the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} taken around the city, circling it once. Then they came back to the camp and spent the night there.
en.R: So Joshua had the priests carry the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} around the city one time. Then everyone went back to the camp and stayed there for the night.

sw.L: Akalizungusha sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuuzunguka mji, likiuzunguka mara moja. Kisha wakaingia kambini, wakalala kambini.
sw.B: Basi aliagiza sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lizungushwe kuuzunguka mji mara moja. Kisha walirudi kambini, wakalala huko.
sw.R: Basi Yoshua aliwaagiza makuhani walibebe sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuuzunguka mji mara moja. Kisha kila mtu alirudi kambini, wakalala huko usiku ule.

es.L: Y él hizo que el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} rodeara la ciudad, dándole una vuelta. Y volvieron al campamento y pasaron la noche en el campamento.
es.B: Así que hizo llevar el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} alrededor de la ciudad, dándole una vuelta. Después volvieron al campamento y pasaron allí la noche.
es.R: Así que Josué hizo que los sacerdotes llevaran el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} una vez alrededor de la ciudad. Luego todos volvieron al campamento y se quedaron allí esa noche.

fr.L: Et il fit faire le tour de la ville à l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, en tournant une fois. Et ils revinrent au camp et passèrent la nuit dans le camp.
fr.B: Il fit donc porter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} autour de la ville, pour en faire une fois le tour. Puis ils revinrent au camp et y passèrent la nuit.
fr.R: Josué a donc fait porter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} par les prêtres une fois autour de la ville. Puis tout le monde est rentré au camp et y a passé la nuit.

vi.L: Và ông cho hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đi vòng quanh thành, đi quanh [thành] một lần. Và họ về trại quân và nghỉ đêm trong trại quân.
vi.B: Vậy ông cho khiêng hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đi vòng quanh thành một lần. Rồi họ trở về trại quân và nghỉ đêm tại đó.
vi.R: Vậy Giô-suê cho các thầy tế lễ khiêng hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đi vòng quanh thành một lần. Rồi mọi người trở về trại quân và ở lại đó qua đêm.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 성 둘레로 한 번 돌게 하였다. 그리고 그들은 진영으로 돌아와 진영에서 밤을 지냈다.
ko.B: 이렇게 여호수아는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤가 성 둘레를 한 번 돌게 하였다. 그런 다음 그들은 진영으로 돌아와 거기에서 밤을 지냈다.
ko.R: 이렇게 여호수아는 제사장들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 메고 성 둘레를 한 번 돌게 하였다. 그런 다음 모두 진영으로 돌아와 거기에서 밤을 보냈다.

decisions.choice: he made the ark go around: Joshua had it carried around
decisions.reason: The verb is causative, "he made go around". The subject is Joshua, who gave the orders; the priests carried the ark (verse 12).

decisions.choice: the camp: Israel's camp at Gilgal
decisions.reason: Israel was camped at Gilgal, east of Jericho (4:19; 5:10). Each day's march ended back in the camp.

decisions.choice: Joshua had the priests carry; everyone
decisions.reason: Readable names who gave the order and who carried the ark (m1), and who went back to the camp.

source.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת־אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And rose early Joshua in the morning, and lifted the priests [the] ark of Yahweh.

en.L: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests lifted up the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Joshua got up early the next morning, and the priests took up the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Early the next morning Joshua got up, and the priests picked up the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} again.

sw.L: Yoshua akaamka mapema asubuhi, na makuhani wakaliinua sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Yoshua aliamka mapema asubuhi iliyofuata, na makuhani wakalibeba sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata, Yoshua aliamka, na makuhani wakalibeba tena sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Y Josué se levantó temprano por la mañana, y los sacerdotes alzaron el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Josué se levantó temprano a la mañana siguiente, y los sacerdotes tomaron el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Temprano a la mañana siguiente, Josué se levantó, y los sacerdotes volvieron a levantar el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Josué se leva de bon matin, et les prêtres soulevèrent l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Le lendemain, Josué se leva de bon matin, et les prêtres prirent l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le lendemain, Josué s’est levé tôt, et les prêtres ont de nouveau pris l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Và Giô-suê dậy sớm vào buổi sáng, và các thầy tế lễ khiêng hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Sáng hôm sau Giô-suê dậy sớm, và các thầy tế lễ khiêng hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lên.
vi.R: Sáng sớm hôm sau, Giô-suê thức dậy, và các thầy tế lễ lại khiêng hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lên.

ko.L: 그리고 여호수아가 아침 일찍 일어났고, 제사장들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 메었다.
ko.B: 다음 날 아침 여호수아가 일찍 일어났고, 제사장들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 메었다.
ko.R: 다음 날 아침 일찍 여호수아가 일어났고, 제사장들은 다시 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 메었다.

decisions.choice: rose early in the morning: set out at first light, ready to act
decisions.reason: The phrase marks readiness and prompt obedience (3:1; Genesis 22:3). This is the morning of the second day (verse 14).

decisions.choice: the next morning; again
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that this is the following day; Readable adds "again".

source.text: וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאִים֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֜וֹת הַיֹּבְלִ֗ים לִפְנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה הֹלְכִ֣ים הָל֔וֹךְ וְתָקְע֖וּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וְהֶחָלוּץ֙ הֹלֵ֣ךְ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וְהַֽמְאַסֵּ֗ף הֹלֵךְ֙ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה הָל֖וֹךְ וְתָק֥וֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And seven the priests carrying seven trumpets of the rams' horns before [the] ark of Yahweh [were] going, going, and they blew on the trumpets; and the armed [one] going before them, and the rear guard going after [the] ark of Yahweh, going and blowing on the trumpets.

en.L: And the seven priests carrying seven trumpets of the rams' horns before the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} were going on steadily, and they blew on the trumpets; and the armed [men] were going before them, and the rear guard was going after the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, going on and blowing on the trumpets.
en.B: The seven priests carrying the seven rams' horns went on in front of the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, blowing the horns as they walked. The armed men went ahead of them, and the rear guard came behind the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, with the horns sounding without a break.
en.R: The seven priests with trumpets walked in front of the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, blowing their trumpets as they went. The soldiers with weapons went ahead of them, and the other soldiers followed behind the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. All the time they marched, the trumpets kept on sounding.

sw.L: Na wale makuhani saba waliobeba baragumu saba za pembe za kondoo dume mbele ya sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} walikwenda wakiendelea, wakapiga baragumu; na wenye silaha walikwenda mbele yao, na walinzi wa nyuma walikwenda nyuma ya sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakienda na kupiga baragumu.
sw.B: Wale makuhani saba waliobeba baragumu saba walikwenda mbele ya sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakipiga baragumu huku wakitembea. Wenye silaha waliwatangulia, na walinzi wa nyuma walifuata nyuma ya sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, baragumu zikilia bila kukoma.
sw.R: Wale makuhani saba wenye baragumu walitembea mbele ya sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakipiga baragumu zao huku wakienda. Askari wenye silaha waliwatangulia, na askari wengine walifuata nyuma ya sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Muda wote walipokuwa wakitembea, baragumu ziliendelea kulia.

es.L: Y los siete sacerdotes que llevaban los siete cuernos de los carneros delante del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} iban andando sin parar, y tocaban los cuernos; y los armados iban delante de ellos, y la retaguardia iba tras el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, andando y tocando los cuernos.
es.B: Los siete sacerdotes que llevaban los siete cuernos de carnero iban delante del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, tocando los cuernos mientras caminaban. Los hombres armados iban delante de ellos, y la retaguardia venía detrás del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, mientras los cuernos sonaban sin parar.
es.R: Los siete sacerdotes con trompetas caminaban delante del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, tocando sus trompetas mientras avanzaban. Los soldados con armas iban delante de ellos, y los demás soldados iban detrás del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Todo el tiempo que marchaban, las trompetas seguían sonando.

fr.L: Et les sept prêtres qui portaient sept trompes de cors de bélier devant l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} marchaient, marchaient, et ils sonnaient des trompes ; et [les hommes] armés marchaient devant eux, et l’arrière-garde marchait derrière l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; on marchait et on sonnait des trompes.
fr.B: Les sept prêtres qui portaient les sept cors de bélier avançaient devant l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} en sonnant du cor tout en marchant. Les hommes armés marchaient devant eux, et l’arrière-garde suivait l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, au son continu des cors.
fr.R: Les sept prêtres avec les trompettes marchaient devant l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} en soufflant dans leurs trompettes. Les soldats armés marchaient devant eux, et les autres soldats suivaient derrière l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Pendant toute la marche, les trompettes n’arrêtaient pas de sonner.

vi.L: Và bảy thầy tế lễ cầm bảy cây kèn bằng sừng cừu đực đi trước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cứ đi tới mãi, và họ thổi kèn; và những [người] vũ trang đi trước họ, và đội hậu quân đi sau hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vừa đi vừa thổi kèn.
vi.B: Bảy thầy tế lễ cầm bảy cây kèn sừng cừu đực đi trước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vừa đi vừa thổi kèn. Những người vũ trang đi trước họ, còn đội hậu quân đi sau hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trong khi tiếng kèn vang lên không ngớt.
vi.R: Bảy thầy tế lễ cầm kèn đi trước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vừa đi vừa thổi kèn. Những người lính cầm vũ khí đi trước họ, và những người lính khác đi theo sau hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Suốt thời gian họ đi, tiếng kèn vẫn vang lên không ngớt.

ko.L: 그리고 숫양 뿔나팔 일곱 개를 든 일곱 제사장이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 앞에서 계속 나아가며 나팔을 불었다. 무장한 사람들은 그들 앞에서 갔고, 후위대는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 뒤를 따라갔으며, 나팔은 계속 울렸다.
ko.B: 숫양 뿔나팔 일곱 개를 든 일곱 제사장은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 앞에서 걸어가며 계속 나팔을 불었다. 무장한 사람들은 그들보다 앞서 갔고, 후위대는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 뒤를 따라왔다. 나팔 소리는 쉬지 않고 울렸다.
ko.R: 나팔을 든 일곱 제사장은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 앞에서 걸어가며 나팔을 불었다. 무기를 든 군인들은 그들 앞에서 갔고, 다른 군인들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 뒤를 따라왔다. 그들이 행진하는 동안 나팔 소리가 계속 울렸다.

decisions.choice: going: the read form
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the Hebrew text can be read as another form of the same verb, "going"; the vowels and the reading tradition give the form used in verse 9. The sense is the same. The pinned data follows the read form. Reviewers should check this against the manuscript notes.

decisions.choice: going on steadily ... going and blowing: as in verse 9
decisions.reason: The order of march on the second day is told again in nearly the same words as the first day (verses 8-9): the armed men, the priests with the horns, the ark, the rear guard, and the horns sounding the whole way.

source.text: וַיָּסֹ֨בּוּ אֶת־הָעִ֜יר בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשֵּׁנִי֙ פַּ֣עַם אַחַ֔ת וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כֹּ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they went around the city on the day the second one time and returned [to] the camp; thus they did six days.

en.L: And they went around the city on the second day one time, and returned [to] the camp. Thus they did [for] six days.
en.B: On the second day they marched around the city once and went back to the camp. They did this for six days.
en.R: On the second day they marched around the city one time and went back to the camp. They did the same thing for six days.

sw.L: Wakauzunguka mji siku ya pili mara moja, wakarudi kambini. Hivyo ndivyo walivyofanya siku sita.
sw.B: Siku ya pili waliuzunguka mji mara moja, wakarudi kambini. Walifanya hivyo kwa siku sita.
sw.R: Siku ya pili waliuzunguka mji mara moja, wakarudi kambini. Walifanya vivyo hivyo kwa siku sita.

es.L: Y rodearon la ciudad el segundo día una vez, y volvieron al campamento. Así hicieron [durante] seis días.
es.B: El segundo día marcharon una vez alrededor de la ciudad y volvieron al campamento. Así lo hicieron durante seis días.
es.R: El segundo día marcharon una vez alrededor de la ciudad y volvieron al campamento. Hicieron lo mismo durante seis días.

fr.L: Et ils firent le tour de la ville le deuxième jour, une fois, et revinrent au camp. Ainsi firent-ils [pendant] six jours.
fr.B: Le deuxième jour, ils firent une fois le tour de la ville et revinrent au camp. Ils firent de même pendant six jours.
fr.R: Le deuxième jour, ils ont fait une fois le tour de la ville et sont rentrés au camp. Ils ont fait la même chose pendant six jours.

vi.L: Và vào ngày thứ hai họ đi vòng quanh thành một lần, rồi trở về trại quân. Họ làm như vậy [trong] sáu ngày.
vi.B: Ngày thứ hai, họ đi vòng quanh thành một lần rồi trở về trại quân. Họ làm như vậy trong sáu ngày.
vi.R: Ngày thứ hai, họ đi vòng quanh thành một lần rồi trở về trại quân. Họ làm giống như vậy trong sáu ngày.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 둘째 날에 성 둘레를 한 번 돌고 진영으로 돌아왔다. 그들은 엿새 동안 그렇게 했다.
ko.B: 둘째 날에도 그들은 성 둘레를 한 번 돌고 진영으로 돌아왔다. 그들은 엿새 동안 이렇게 했다.
ko.R: 둘째 날에도 그들은 성 둘레를 한 번 돌고 진영으로 돌아왔다. 그들은 엿새 동안 똑같이 했다.

decisions.choice: thus they did six days: the march repeated each day through the sixth
decisions.reason: The verse sums up the second to the sixth days: one circuit a day and back to camp, just as the LORD had commanded in verse 3.

source.text: וַיְהִ֣י׀בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וַיַּשְׁכִּ֨מוּ֙ כַּעֲל֣וֹת הַשַּׁ֔חַר וַיָּסֹ֧בּוּ אֶת־הָעִ֛יר כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט הַזֶּ֖ה שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים רַ֚ק בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא סָבְב֥וּ אֶת־הָעִ֖יר שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was on the day the seventh, and they rose early at [the] coming up of the dawn and went around the city according to the manner the this seven times; only on the day the that they went around the city seven times.

en.L: And it was on the seventh day, and they rose early, at the coming up of the dawn, and went around the city in this same manner seven times. Only on that day did they go around the city seven times.
en.B: On the seventh day they got up at daybreak and marched around the city in the same way, but this time seven times. That was the only day they went around the city seven times.
en.R: On the seventh day they got up at dawn. They marched around the city the same way as before, but this time they went around seven times. This was the only day they did that.

sw.L: Ikawa siku ya saba, wakaamka mapema, kulipopambazuka, wakauzunguka mji kwa namna ile ile mara saba. Siku hiyo tu ndiyo waliyouzunguka mji mara saba.
sw.B: Siku ya saba waliamka alfajiri, wakauzunguka mji kwa namna ile ile, lakini safari hii mara saba. Hiyo ndiyo siku pekee waliyouzunguka mji mara saba.
sw.R: Siku ya saba waliamka alfajiri. Waliuzunguka mji kwa namna ile ile kama siku zilizopita, lakini safari hii walizunguka mara saba. Hiyo ndiyo siku pekee waliyofanya hivyo.

es.L: Y sucedió el séptimo día que se levantaron temprano, al subir el alba, y rodearon la ciudad de esta misma manera siete veces. Solo aquel día rodearon la ciudad siete veces.
es.B: El séptimo día se levantaron al amanecer y marcharon alrededor de la ciudad de la misma manera, pero esta vez siete veces. Aquel fue el único día en que dieron siete vueltas a la ciudad.
es.R: El séptimo día se levantaron al amanecer. Marcharon alrededor de la ciudad como antes, pero esta vez dieron siete vueltas. Fue el único día en que lo hicieron.

fr.L: Et il arriva, le septième jour, qu’ils se levèrent de bon matin, au lever de l’aurore, et firent le tour de la ville de cette même manière, sept fois. Ce jour-là seulement, ils firent le tour de la ville sept fois.
fr.B: Le septième jour, ils se levèrent à l’aube et firent le tour de la ville de la même manière, mais cette fois sept fois. Ce fut le seul jour où ils firent sept fois le tour de la ville.
fr.R: Le septième jour, ils se sont levés à l’aube. Ils ont fait le tour de la ville comme avant, mais cette fois, ils en ont fait sept fois le tour. C’est le seul jour où ils ont fait cela.

vi.L: Và xảy ra vào ngày thứ bảy, họ dậy sớm, lúc rạng đông, và đi vòng quanh thành theo cách ấy bảy lần. Chỉ trong ngày ấy họ đi vòng quanh thành bảy lần.
vi.B: Vào ngày thứ bảy, họ dậy lúc rạng đông và đi vòng quanh thành cũng theo cách ấy, nhưng lần này đi bảy vòng. Chỉ có ngày ấy họ đi vòng quanh thành bảy lần.
vi.R: Vào ngày thứ bảy, họ thức dậy lúc rạng đông. Họ đi vòng quanh thành giống như trước, nhưng lần này họ đi bảy vòng. Chỉ có ngày ấy họ làm như vậy.

ko.L: 그리고 일곱째 날이 되자, 그들은 동틀 무렵에 일찍 일어나 같은 방식으로 성 둘레를 일곱 번 돌았다. 그날에만 그들은 성 둘레를 일곱 번 돌았다.
ko.B: 일곱째 날에 그들은 동틀 무렵에 일어나 같은 방식으로 성 둘레를 행진하되, 이번에는 일곱 번 돌았다. 그들이 성 둘레를 일곱 번 돈 날은 그날뿐이었다.
ko.R: 일곱째 날에 그들은 새벽에 일어났다. 그들은 전과 같은 방식으로 성 둘레를 행진했는데, 이번에는 일곱 번을 돌았다. 그렇게 한 날은 그날뿐이었다.

decisions.choice: in this manner: in the same order of march
decisions.reason: The word means a set way or pattern. The procession was the same as on the six days before, with priests, horns, ark and armed men in their places; only the number of circuits changed.

decisions.choice: only on that day: the seventh day stands apart
decisions.reason: The repeated words stress that this day was unlike the others, as verse 4 had commanded.

decisions.choice: but this time
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable mark the change from the earlier days, which the Hebrew shows by repeating "seven times".

source.text: וַיְהִי֙ בַּפַּ֣עַם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔ית תָּקְע֥וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בַּשּׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ אֶל־הָעָם֙ הָרִ֔יעוּ כִּֽי־נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־הָעִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was at the time the seventh, blew the priests on the trumpets, and said Joshua to the people, shout, for has given Yahweh to you the city.

en.L: And it was at the seventh time, [when] the priests blew on the trumpets, that Joshua said to the people, "Shout! For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has given you the city.
en.B: The seventh time around, when the priests sounded the horns, Joshua said to the people, "Shout! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has handed the city over to you.
en.R: On the seventh time around, the priests blew their trumpets, and Joshua told the people, "Shout! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has given you the city!

sw.L: Ikawa mara ya saba, makuhani [walipo]piga baragumu, Yoshua akawaambia watu, "Pigeni kelele! Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewapa mji.
sw.B: Walipozunguka mara ya saba, makuhani walipopiga baragumu, Yoshua aliwaambia watu, "Pigeni kelele! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewakabidhi mji huu.

es.B: A la séptima vuelta, cuando los sacerdotes tocaron los cuernos, Josué dijo al pueblo: «¡{{plural_you:Griten|Gritad}}! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha entregado la ciudad.
es.R: En la séptima vuelta, los sacerdotes tocaron las trompetas, y Josué le dijo al pueblo: «¡{{plural_you:Griten|Gritad}}! ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado la ciudad!
